description: This file defines the CachedContentRepository class, implementing a cache-decorated wrapper around a ContentRepository, with SWR (stale-while-revalidate) semantics. It manages cached access to content data, background refreshes, and cache busting, and interacts with an optional database for watch progress storage.

classes.name: CachedContentRepository
classes.description: A cache-decorated implementation of ContentRepository with SWR semantics, supporting cache-first reads, background refreshes, and cache busting.

methods.name: fetchHomeFeed
methods.description: Fetches the home feed with cache check (fresh or stale) and initiates background refresh if applicable.

methods.name: _refreshHomeFeed
methods.description: Background method to refresh home feed data from remote and update cache.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves content details by ID, with cache checks and background refresh.

methods.name: _refreshDetails
methods.description: Background refresh for content details by ID from remote.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs search with short-lived cache and background refresh strategies.

methods.name: recordPlaybackProgress
methods.description: Records playback progress to the local database.

methods.name: recordPlaybackCompleted
methods.description: Marks playback as completed in the database.

methods.name: getPlaybackProgressSeconds
methods.description: Retrieves playback progress from the database.

methods.name: getRecentWatchHistory
methods.description: Fetches recent watch history from the database.
